The correct answer is D. When an Auto Scaling group detects that an instance is unhealthy, the default behavior is to terminate the instance and start a new one to replace it. If the architect wants to troubleshoot this "unhealthy" instance, he or she must first prevent the Auto Scaling group from deleting it. By suspending (Suspend) the "Terminate" process of the Auto Scaling group, you can prevent the execution instance from being automatically terminated, allowing the architect enough time to use Session Manager to log in and perform diagnosis.

Choice A is incorrect because pausing the HealthCheck process causes the Auto Scaling group to stop checking the health status of executions, which does not directly prevent executions that have been marked as unhealthy from being terminated.

Option B is incorrect because EC2 execution individual termination protection (Termination Protection) is for "manual" termination or protection through API calls. It cannot prevent the Auto Scaling group from automatically terminating in order to maintain the group size.

Option C is incorrect because changing the termination policy (Termination Policy) only determines "which" execution instance will be deleted first when the group needs to reduce capacity, and does not prevent unhealthy execution instances from being terminated.
題目(中):
一家大型公司正在運行一個熱門的網頁應用程式。該應用程式運行在私有子網路中 Auto Scaling 群組的多個 Amazon EC2 Linux 執行個體上。一個應用程式負載平衡器 (ALB) 將流量導向至該私有子網路中 Auto Scaling 群組內的執行個體。AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 已完成設定，且所有 EC2 執行個體上皆已運行 AWS Systems Manager Agent。
公司最近發布了應用程式的新版本。目前有一些 EC2 執行個體被標記為「不健康」(unhealthy) 並正在被終止。結果導致應用程式的處理能力下降。解決方案架構師嘗試透過分析從應用程式收集的 Amazon CloudWatch 日誌來確定根本原因，但日誌結果並不具決定性。解決方案架構師應該如何存取 EC2 執行個體以進行故障排除？
選項(中):
A. 暫停 Auto Scaling 群組的 HealthCheck 擴展流程。使用 Session Manager 登入被標記為不健康的執行個體。
B. 啟用 EC2 執行個體終止保護。使用 Session Manager 登入被標記為不健康的執行個體。
C. 將 Auto Scaling 群組的終止策略設定為 OldestInstance。使用 Session Manager 登入被標記為不健康的執行個體。
D. 暫停 Auto Scaling 群組的 Terminate 流程。使用 Session Manager 登入被標記為不健康的執行個體。
解析(中):
正確答案是 D。當 Auto Scaling 群組偵測到執行個體不健康時，預設行為是終止該執行個體並啟動一個新的來取代它。如果架構師想要對該「不健康」的執行個體進行故障排除，必須先阻止 Auto Scaling 群組將其刪除。透過暫停 (Suspend) Auto Scaling 群組的「Terminate」流程，可以防止該執行個體被自動終止，從而讓架構師有足夠的時間使用 Session Manager 登入並進行診斷。

選項 A 不正確，因為暫停 HealthCheck 流程會導致 Auto Scaling 群組停止檢查執行個體的健康狀態，這並不能直接阻止已經被標記為不健康的執行個體被終止。

選項 B 不正確，因為 EC2 執行個體終止保護 (Termination Protection) 是針對「手動」終止或透過 API 呼叫的保護，它無法阻止 Auto Scaling 群組為了維護群組大小而進行的自動終止行為。

選項 C 不正確，因為更改終止策略 (Termination Policy) 僅決定了當群組需要縮減容量時「哪一個」執行個體會被優先刪除，並不能阻止不健康的執行個體被終止。

題目(英):
A company wants to deploy an AWS WAF solution to manage AWS WAF rules across multiple AWS accounts. The accounts are
managed under different OUs in AWS Organizations.
Administrators must be able to add or remove accounts or OUs from managed AWS WAF rule sets as needed. Administrators
also must have the ability to automatically update and remediate noncompliant AWS WAF rules in all accounts.
Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Use AWS Firewall Manager to manage AWS WAF rules across accounts in the organization. Use an AWS Systems
Manager Parameter Store parameter to store account numbers and OUs to manage. Update the parameter as needed to
add or remove accounts or OUs. Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to identify any changes to the parameter and to invoke
an AWS Lambda function to update the security policy in the Firewall Manager administrative account.
B. Deploy an organization-wide AWS Config rule that requires all resources in the selected OUs to associate the AWS WAF
rules. Deploy automated remediation actions by using AWS Lambda to fix noncompliant resources. Deploy AWS WAF rules
by using an AWS CloudFormation stack set to target the same OUs where the AWS Config rule is applied.
C. Create AWS WAF rules in the management account of the organization. Use AWS Lambda environment variables to store
account numbers and OUs to manage. Update environment variables as needed to add or remove accounts or OUs. Create
cross-account IAM roles in member accounts. Assume the roles by using AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) in the
Lambda function to create and update AWS WAF rules in the member accounts.
D. Use AWS Control Tower to manage AWS WAF rules across accounts in the organization. Use AWS Key Management
Service (AWS KMS) to store account numbers and OUs to manage. Update AWS KMS as needed to add or remove accounts
or OUs. Create IAM users in member accounts. Allow AWS Control Tower in the management account to use the access key
and secret access key to create and update AWS WAF rules in the member accounts.
解析(英):
The correct answer is A for the following reasons:
1. **AWS Firewall Manager Core Benefits**: Firewall Manager is designed to centrally manage security principles, including WAF, in AWS Organizations. It natively supports rule deployment based on OUs and accounts, and has the function of automatically repairing non-compliant rules, which fully meets the requirements of the question for "management rules" and "automatic repair".
2. **Lowest operating expenses**: Option A stores configurations through Parameter Store, and combines EventBridge and Lambda to achieve automated updates. This is the most standard and low-maintenance cost approach that combines Firewall Manager's principle management with dynamic account management.

Why the other options are incorrect:
- **Option B**: Although AWS Config and CloudFormation StackSets can implement deployment, this approach is very complex and difficult to maintain. Config rules are mainly used for "detection" rather than "centralized management of WAF principles", and the management overhead of StackSets is much higher than that of Firewall Manager, which does not meet the requirements of "minimum operating overhead".
- **Option C**: This option requires manually writing a lot of Lambda code to handle cross-account STS assuming roles (AssumeRole) and WAF API calls. This not only has high development costs, but also lacks the automated compliance monitoring and repair functions natively provided by Firewall Manager, which is "reinventing the wheel."
- **Option D**: This option recommends creating an IAM user in the member account and using an access key, which is a serious violation of AWS security best practices (the use of long-term access keys should be avoided as much as possible). In addition, Control Tower itself is not a tool directly used for fine-grained management of WAF rules, and this architecture is neither secure nor scalable.
題目(中): 一家公司希望部署 AWS WAF 解決方案，以管理多個 AWS 帳號中的 AWS WAF 規則。這些帳號在 AWS Organizations 下的不同組織單位（OU）中進行管理。管理員必須能夠根據需要從受管理的 AWS WAF 規則集中新增或移除帳號或 OU。管理員還必須具備自動更新和修復所有帳號中不合規 AWS WAF 規則的能力。哪種解決方案能以最少的營運開銷滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 使用 AWS Firewall Manager 來管理組織中跨帳號的 AWS WAF 規則。使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 參數來儲存要管理的帳號編號和 OU。根據需要更新參數以新增或移除帳號或 OU。使用 Amazon EventBridge 規則來識別參數的任何變更，並呼叫 AWS Lambda 函數來更新 Firewall Manager 管理帳號中的安全性原則。
B. 部署一個組織範圍的 AWS Config 規則，要求所選 OU 中的所有資源都必須關聯 AWS WAF 規則。使用 AWS Lambda 部署自動化修復動作以修復不合規的資源。使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 部署 AWS WAF 規則，以鎖定應用了 AWS Config 規則的相同 OU。
C. 在組織的管理帳號中建立 AWS WAF 規則。使用 AWS Lambda 環境變數來儲存要管理的帳號編號和 OU。根據需要更新環境變數以新增或移除帳號或 OU。在成員帳號中建立跨帳號 IAM 角色。在 Lambda 函數中使用 AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) 來扮演這些角色，以便在成員帳號中建立和更新 AWS WAF 規則。
D. 使用 AWS Control Tower 來管理組織中跨帳號的 AWS WAF 規則。使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 來儲存要管理的帳號編號和 OU。根據需要更新 AWS KMS 以新增或移除帳號或 OU。在成員帳號中建立 IAM 使用者。允許管理帳號中的 AWS Control Tower 使用存取金鑰（Access Key）和秘密存取金鑰（Secret Access Key）在成員帳號中建立和更新 AWS WAF 規則。
解析(中):
正確答案為 A，原因如下：
1. **AWS Firewall Manager 的核心優勢**：Firewall Manager 專為集中管理 AWS Organizations 中的安全性原則（包括 WAF）而設計。它原生支援根據 OU 和帳號進行規則部署，並具備自動修復不合規規則的功能，這完全符合題目對於「管理規則」與「自動修復」的需求。
2. **營運開銷最低**：選項 A 透過 Parameter Store 儲存配置，並結合 EventBridge 與 Lambda 實現自動化更新，這是將 Firewall Manager 的原則管理與動態帳號管理結合的最標準且低維護成本做法。

其他選項為何不正確：
- **選項 B**：雖然 AWS Config 和 CloudFormation StackSets 可以實現部署，但這種方式非常複雜且難以維護。Config 規則主要用於「偵測」而非「集中管理 WAF 原則」，且 StackSets 的管理開銷遠高於 Firewall Manager，不符合「最少營運開銷」的要求。
- **選項 C**：此方案需要手動編寫大量 Lambda 程式碼來處理跨帳號的 STS 扮演角色（AssumeRole）以及 WAF API 的呼叫。這不僅開發成本高，且缺乏 Firewall Manager 原生提供的自動化合規性監控與修復功能，屬於「重新發明輪子」。
- **選項 D**：此方案建議在成員帳號中建立 IAM 使用者並使用存取金鑰（Access Key），這嚴重違反了 AWS 安全最佳實踐（應盡量避免使用長期存取金鑰）。此外，Control Tower 本身並非直接用於細粒度管理 WAF 規則的工具，此架構既不安全也不具備擴充性。

題目(英):
A solutions architect is auditing the security setup or an AWS Lambda function for a company. The Lambda function retrieves,
the latest changes from an Amazon Aurora database. The Lambda function and the database run in the same VPC. Lambda
environment variables are providing the database credentials to the Lambda function.
The Lambda function aggregates data and makes the data available in an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for server-side
encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys (SSE-KMS). The data must not travel across the Internet. If any database
credentials become compromised, the company needs a solution that minimizes the impact of the compromise.
What should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Enable IAM database authentication on the Aurora DB cluster. Change the IAM role for the Lambda function to allow the
function to access the database by using IAM database authentication. Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in
the VPC.
B. Enable IAM database authentication on the Aurora DB cluster. Change the IAM role for the Lambda function to allow the
function to access the database by using IAM database authentication. Enforce HTTPS on the connection to Amazon S3
during data transfers.
C. Save the database credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Set up password rotation on the credentials in
Parameter Store. Change the IAM role for the Lambda function to allow the function to access Parameter Store. Modify the
Lambda function to retrieve the credentials from Parameter Store. Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the
VPC.
D. Save the database credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Set up password rotation on the credentials in Secrets Manager.
Change the IAM role for the Lambda function to allow the function to access Secrets Manager. Modify the Lambda function
to retrieve the credentials from Secrets Manager. Enforce HTTPS on the connection to Amazon S3 during data transfers.
解析(英):
There are two core requirements for this question: one is to ensure that data transmission does not pass through the Internet, and the other is to reduce the impact of credential leakage.
1. **Why A is the correct answer**:
   - **IAM Database Authentication**: Access Aurora through IAM authentication without the need to store static passwords in your code or environment variables. If credentials (IAM roles) are leaked, permissions can be revoked immediately, and IAM verification itself does not rely on long-term passwords, which greatly reduces the risk of traditional credential leaks.
   - **Gateway VPC Endpoint**: This is key to ensuring that data "doesn't go through the Internet." By establishing an S3 gateway endpoint within the VPC, Lambda's traffic to and from S3 will be routed through the AWS internal network instead of the public Internet.

2. **Why the other options are incorrect**:
   - **Option B**: Although IAM repository verification is enabled, it only mentions forcing HTTPS. Although HTTPS encrypts the transmission content, the traffic may still pass through the Internet (unless there is a VPC endpoint), which cannot meet the strict network isolation requirements of "data must not pass through the Internet".
   - **Option C**: Although Parameter Store is used and VPC endpoints are deployed, Parameter Store is not a service specifically designed for database credential management (Secrets Manager is preferred), and using static credentials (even with rotation) is still less secure than IAM database verification by directly eliminating passwords.
   - **Option D**: Although Secrets Manager is a best practice for managing credentials and has a rotation function, it also does not solve the problem of "data not passing through the Internet". Merely forcing HTTPS does not guarantee that traffic stays entirely within the AWS internal network; VPC endpoints must be used to ensure that traffic does not traverse the internet.
題目(中): 一位解決方案架構師正在審核一家公司的 AWS Lambda 函數安全設定。該 Lambda 函數會從 Amazon Aurora 資料庫擷取最新變更。Lambda 函數與資料庫皆運行於同一個 VPC 中。目前 Lambda 環境變數正提供資料庫憑證給 Lambda 函數。Lambda 函數會彙總資料，並將資料存入一個已設定使用 AWS KMS 管理金鑰進行伺服器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 的 Amazon S3 儲存貯體中。資料傳輸過程不得經過網際網路。若任何資料庫憑證遭到洩漏，公司需要一個能將影響降至最低的解決方案。解決方案架構師應建議採取什麼措施來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在 Aurora 資料庫叢集上啟用 IAM 資料庫驗證。更改 Lambda 函數的 IAM 角色，以允許該函數透過 IAM 資料庫驗證存取資料庫。在 VPC 中部署 Amazon S3 的閘道 VPC 端點 (Gateway VPC Endpoint)。
B. 在 Aurora 資料庫叢集上啟用 IAM 資料庫驗證。更改 Lambda 函數的 IAM 角色，以允許該函數透過 IAM 資料庫驗證存取資料庫。在資料傳輸期間強制對 Amazon S3 的連線使用 HTTPS。
C. 將資料庫憑證儲存於 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store。在 Parameter Store 中設定憑證的密碼輪替。更改 Lambda 函數的 IAM 角色，以允許該函數存取 Parameter Store。修改 Lambda 函數以從 Parameter Store 擷取憑證。在 VPC 中部署 Amazon S3 的閘道 VPC 端點。
D. 將資料庫憑證儲存於 AWS Secrets Manager。在 Secrets Manager 中設定憑證的密碼輪替。更改 Lambda 函數的 IAM 角色，以允許該函數存取 Secrets Manager。修改 Lambda 函數以從 Secrets Manager 擷取憑證。在資料傳輸期間強制對 Amazon S3 的連線使用 HTTPS。
解析(中):
本題的核心需求有二：一是確保資料傳輸不經過網際網路，二是降低憑證洩漏的影響。
1. **為何 A 是正確答案**：
   - **IAM 資料庫驗證**：透過 IAM 驗證存取 Aurora，無需在程式碼或環境變數中儲存靜態密碼。若憑證（IAM 角色）洩漏，可立即撤銷權限，且 IAM 驗證本身不依賴長期密碼，大幅降低了傳統憑證洩漏的風險。
   - **閘道 VPC 端點**：這是確保資料「不經過網際網路」的關鍵。透過在 VPC 內建立 S3 的閘道端點，Lambda 存取 S3 的流量將會透過 AWS 內部網路路由，而非透過公用網際網路。

2. **為何其他選項不正確**：
   - **選項 B**：雖然啟用了 IAM 資料庫驗證，但僅提到強制 HTTPS。HTTPS 雖然加密了傳輸內容，但流量仍可能經由網際網路（除非有 VPC 端點），這無法滿足「資料不得經過網際網路」的嚴格網路隔離需求。
   - **選項 C**：雖然使用了 Parameter Store 並部署了 VPC 端點，但 Parameter Store 並非專門為資料庫憑證管理設計的服務（Secrets Manager 才是首選），且使用靜態憑證（即使有輪替）在安全性上仍不如 IAM 資料庫驗證直接消除密碼來得徹底。
   - **選項 D**：雖然 Secrets Manager 是管理憑證的最佳實踐，且具備輪替功能，但它同樣沒有解決「資料不經過網際網路」的問題。僅強制 HTTPS 並不能保證流量完全留在 AWS 內部網路中，必須使用 VPC 端點才能確保流量不經過網際網路。

題目(英):
A large mobile gaming company has successfully migrated all of its on-premises infrastructure to the AWS Cloud. A solutions
architect is reviewing the environment to ensure that it was built according to the design and that it is running in alignment
with the Well-Architected Framework.
While reviewing previous monthly costs in Cost Explorer, the solutions architect notices that the creation and subsequent
termination of several large instance types account for a high proportion of the costs. The solutions architect finds out that the
company’s developers are launching new Amazon EC2 instances as part of their testing and that the developers are not using
the appropriate instance types.
The solutions architect must implement a control mechanism to limit the instance types that only the developers can launch.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create a desired-instance-type managed rule in AWS Config. Configure the rule with the instance types that are allowed.
Attach the rule to an event to run each time a new EC2 instance is launched.
B. In the EC2 console, create a launch template that specifies the instance types that are allowed. Assign the launch
template to the developers’ IAM accounts.
C. Create a new IAM policy. Specify the instance types that are allowed. Attach the policy to an IAM group that contains the
IAM accounts for the developers
D. Use EC2 Image Builder to create an image pipeline for the developers and assist them in the creation of a golden image.
解析(英):
The correct answer is C. In AWS, the most direct and effective way to limit the types of resources that a user can launch (such as EC2 execution instance types) is to use an IAM Policy. By setting the Condition Key of `ec2:InstanceType` in the policy, you can clearly define the types of execution entities that are allowed or denied. Attaching this policy to the IAM group to which the developer belongs enforces this restriction and ensures that developers cannot launch unauthorized high-cost execution entities.

Option A is incorrect because AWS Config is mainly used for resource compliance monitoring and auditing. Although it can detect execution instances that do not meet specifications, it cannot "prevent" developers from creating these execution instances at startup. It can only issue warnings or trigger automated repairs afterwards.

Option B is incorrect because Launch Template is a tool used to simplify the startup process and does not itself have the function of enforcing permission control. Developers can still choose not to use the template, or manually override the setting at launch.

Choice D is incorrect because EC2 Image Builder is used to automate the creation of images and has nothing to do with limiting a developer's permissions to launch instances. Even if a golden image is provided, developers can still manually select a different execution instance type when launching an execution instance, so the restriction cannot be achieved.
題目(中): 一家大型手機遊戲公司已成功將其所有地端基礎設施遷移至 AWS 雲端。一位解決方案架構師正在審查該環境，以確保其建置符合設計，並確保其運作符合「架構完善框架」（Well-Architected Framework）。在審查 Cost Explorer 的過往每月成本時，架構師發現建立並隨後終止多個大型執行個體類型佔用了很大比例的成本。架構師發現公司的開發人員在測試過程中啟動了新的 Amazon EC2 執行個體，且開發人員並未使用適當的執行個體類型。架構師必須實施一種控制機制，以限制開發人員僅能啟動特定的執行個體類型。哪種解決方案符合這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 在 AWS Config 中建立一個 desired-instance-type 的受管規則。使用允許的執行個體類型來配置該規則。將此規則附加到事件，以便在每次啟動新的 EC2 執行個體時執行。
B. 在 EC2 主控台中，建立一個指定允許執行個體類型的啟動範本（Launch Template）。將此啟動範本指派給開發人員的 IAM 帳號。
C. 建立一個新的 IAM 政策。指定允許的執行個體類型。將此政策附加到包含開發人員 IAM 帳號的 IAM 群組。
D. 使用 EC2 Image Builder 為開發人員建立一個映像檔管道（Image Pipeline），並協助他們建立黃金映像檔（Golden Image）。
解析(中):
正確答案是 C。在 AWS 中，要限制使用者可以啟動的資源類型（例如 EC2 執行個體類型），最直接且有效的方法是使用 IAM 政策（IAM Policy）。透過在政策中設定 `ec2:InstanceType` 的條件鍵（Condition Key），可以明確定義允許或拒絕的執行個體類型。將此政策附加到開發人員所屬的 IAM 群組，即可強制執行此限制，確保開發人員無法啟動未經授權的高成本執行個體。

選項 A 不正確，因為 AWS Config 主要用於資源合規性監控與稽核，雖然可以偵測到不符合規範的執行個體，但它無法在啟動當下「阻止」開發人員建立這些執行個體，只能在事後發出警告或觸發自動化修復。

選項 B 不正確，因為啟動範本（Launch Template）是用於簡化啟動流程的工具，它本身並不具備強制執行權限控制的功能。開發人員仍然可以選擇不使用該範本，或在啟動時手動覆蓋設定。

選項 D 不正確，因為 EC2 Image Builder 用於自動化建立映像檔，這與限制開發人員啟動執行個體的權限無關。即使提供了黃金映像檔，開發人員在啟動執行個體時仍可手動選擇其他執行個體類型，因此無法達成限制目的。

題目(英):
A company is developing and hosting several projects in the AWS Cloud. The projects are developed across multiple AWS
accounts under the same organization in AWS Organizations. The company requires the cost for cloud infrastructure to be
allocated to the owning project. The team responsible for all of the AWS accounts has discovered that several Amazon EC2
instances are lacking the Project tag used for cost allocation.
Which actions should a solutions architect lake to resolve the problem and prevent it from happening in the future? (Choose
three.)
選項(英):
A. Create an AWS Config rule in each account to find resources with missing tags.
B. Create an SCP in the organization with a deny action for ec2:RunInstances if the Project tag is missing.
C. Use Amazon Inspector in the organization to find resources with missing tags.
D. Create an IAM policy in each account with a deny action for ec2:RunInstances if the Project tag is missing.
E. Create an AWS Config aggregator for the organization to collect a list of EC2 instances with the missing Project tag. F. Use AWS Security Hub to aggregate a list of EC2 instances with the missing Project tag.
解析(英):
This question aims to solve the needs of "detecting the missing tags of existing resources" and "enforcing that future resources must have tags".

The correct answer is ABE, and the analysis is as follows:
1. **A (Correct)**: AWS Config rules (such as `ec2-instance-tagged`) can continuously monitor resource status and identify untagged EC2 instances. This can effectively solve the problem of "finding existing resources missing tags".
2. **B (Correct)**: SCP is a feature of AWS Organizations that can apply to the entire organization or to a specific OU. By setting up the SCP to reject `ec2:RunInstances` if the request does not include the Project tag, you can enforce the tag policy at the source and prevent missing tags from happening in the future.
3. **E (Correct)**: Since the project is distributed among multiple accounts, the AWS Config Aggregator can be used to centralize the compliance data of all accounts into a central account for review, making it easier for the management team to uniformly monitor and track resources that lack tags in all accounts.

Error option analysis:
* **C (Error)**: Amazon Inspector is primarily used for automated security assessments to identify software vulnerabilities and unexpected network exposures, and is not used to check resource tag compliance.
* **D (Error)**: Although IAM policies can restrict permissions, to enforce this rule on multiple accounts, IAM policies must be managed individually in each account, which is extremely expensive to manage and difficult to maintain in a multi-account environment. In contrast, SCP is a best practice for governance at the organizational level.
* **F (Error)**: Although AWS Security Hub can aggregate security findings, it is not a tool specifically designed to check resource tag compliance, and its functional positioning is different from AWS Config's application for tag governance.
題目(中): 一家公司正在 AWS 雲端開發並託管多個專案。這些專案分佈在 AWS Organizations 下同一個組織的多個 AWS 帳號中。公司要求將雲端基礎設施的成本分配給所屬的專案。負責所有 AWS 帳號的團隊發現，有幾個 Amazon EC2 實例缺少用於成本分配的「Project」標籤。解決方案架構師應採取哪些行動來解決此問題並防止未來再次發生？（選擇三項。）
選項(中):
A. 在每個帳號中建立 AWS Config 規則，以找出缺少標籤的資源。
B. 在組織中建立服務控制政策 (SCP)，若缺少「Project」標籤，則拒絕 ec2:RunInstances 動作。
C. 在組織中使用 Amazon Inspector 來找出缺少標籤的資源。
D. 在每個帳號中建立 IAM 政策，若缺少「Project」標籤，則拒絕 ec2:RunInstances 動作。
E. 為組織建立 AWS Config 彙總器 (Aggregator)，以收集缺少「Project」標籤的 EC2 實例清單。
F. 使用 AWS Security Hub 來彙總缺少「Project」標籤的 EC2 實例清單。
解析(中):
本題旨在解決「偵測現有資源缺失標籤」以及「強制未來資源必須具備標籤」的需求。

正確答案為 ABE，解析如下：
1. **A (正確)**：AWS Config 規則（例如 `ec2-instance-tagged`）可以持續監控資源狀態，並識別出未標記的 EC2 實例。這能有效解決「發現現有資源缺少標籤」的問題。
2. **B (正確)**：SCP 是 AWS Organizations 的功能，可應用於整個組織或特定 OU。透過在 SCP 中設定拒絕 `ec2:RunInstances`（若請求中未包含 Project 標籤），可以從源頭強制執行標籤政策，防止未來再次發生缺少標籤的情況。
3. **E (正確)**：由於專案分佈在多個帳號中，使用 AWS Config 彙總器 (Aggregator) 可以將所有帳號的合規性資料集中到一個中心帳號進行檢視，方便管理團隊統一監控與追蹤所有帳號中缺少標籤的資源。

錯誤選項解析：
* **C (錯誤)**：Amazon Inspector 主要用於自動化安全評估，以識別軟體漏洞和非預期的網路暴露，並非用於檢查資源標籤的合規性。
* **D (錯誤)**：IAM 政策雖然可以限制權限，但若要對多個帳號強制執行此規則，必須在每個帳號中個別管理 IAM 政策，這在多帳號環境下管理成本極高且難以維護。相比之下，SCP 是在組織層級進行治理的最佳實踐。
* **F (錯誤)**：雖然 AWS Security Hub 可以彙總安全發現，但它並非專門用於檢查資源標籤合規性的工具，且其功能定位與 AWS Config 在標籤治理上的應用不同。

題目(英):
A company has an on-premises monitoring solution using a PostgreSQL database for persistence of events. The database is
unable to scale due to heavy ingestion and it frequently runs out of storage.
The company wants to create a hybrid solution and has already set up a VPN connection between its network and AWS. The
solution should include the following attributes:
• Managed AWS services to minimize operational complexity.
• A buffer that automatically scales to match the throughput of data and requires no ongoing administration.
• A visualization tool to create dashboards to observe events in near-real time.
• Support for semi-structured JSON data and dynamic schemas.
Which combination of components will enable the company to create a monitoring solution that will satisfy these
requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to buffer events. Create an AWS Lambda function to process and transform events.
B. Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to buffer events. Create an AWS Lambda function to process and transform
events.
C. Configure an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster to receive events. Use Amazon QuickSight to read from the
database and create near-real-time visualizations and dashboards.
D. Configure Amazon Elasticsearch Service (Amazon ES) to receive events. Use the Kibana endpoint deployed with Amazon
ES to create near-real-time visualizations and dashboards.
E. Configure an Amazon Neptune DB instance to receive events. Use Amazon QuickSight to read from the database and
create near-real-time visualizations and dashboards.
解析(英):

題目(英):
A team collects and routes behavioral data for an entire company. The company runs a Multi-AZ VPC environment with public
subnets, private subnets, and in internet gateway. Each public subnet also contains a NAT gateway. Most of the company’s
applications read from and write to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Most of the workloads run in private subnets.
A solutions architect must review the infrastructure. The solution architect needs to reduce costs and maintain the function of
the applications. The solutions architect uses Cost Explorer and notices that the cost in the EC2-Other category is consistently
high. A further review shows that NatGateway-Bytes charges are increasing the cost in the EC2-Other category.
What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Enable VPC Flow Logs. Use Amazon Athena to analyze the logs for traffic that can be removed. Ensure that security
groups are blocking traffic that is responsible for high costs.
B. Add an interface VPC endpoint for Kinesis Data Streams to the VPC. Ensure that applications have the correct IAM
permissions to use the interface VPC endpoint.
C. Enable VPC Flow Logs and Amazon Detective. Review Detective findings for traffic that is not related to Kinesis Data
Streams. Configure security groups to block that traffic.
D. Add an interface VPC endpoint for Kinesis Data Streams to the VPC. Ensure that the VPC endpoint policy allows traffic
from the applications.
解析(英):
The core problem of this question is "the NAT gateway data transmission cost is too high". In AWS, when resources in a private subnet (such as EC2 instances) need to access public services (such as Kinesis Data Streams), the traffic will pass through the NAT gateway, which will incur data processing fees and data transmission fees.

Analysis of the correct answer D:
By establishing an Interface VPC Endpoint (based on AWS PrivateLink) for Kinesis Data Streams, traffic will be transmitted directly within the AWS internal network without going through a NAT gateway. This not only significantly reduces the data transmission cost of the NAT gateway, but also improves network security. Setting up a VPC endpoint policy is a necessary step to ensure that applications can correctly access the endpoint.

Reasons why other options are incorrect:
A and C: VPC Flow Logs are only used to monitor and record traffic, and cannot change the traffic path or reduce the transmission cost of the NAT gateway. Blocking traffic using security groups may prevent your application from functioning properly and will not resolve Kinesis data transfer charges.
B: Although adding an interface VPC endpoint is the right direction, option B emphasizes "IAM permissions", while option D emphasizes "VPC endpoint policy". In AWS architectural practice, to control who can access services through VPC endpoints, VPC Endpoint Policy is a standard control mechanism, and the description of option D is more in line with the integrity requirements of the architectural design. Additionally, IAM permissions are typically configured by default, while endpoint policies are key settings for endpoint access control.
題目(中): 一個團隊負責收集並路由全公司的行為數據。該公司在多可用區（Multi-AZ）的 VPC 環境中運行，包含公有子網、私有子網以及一個網際網路閘道（Internet Gateway）。每個公有子網中也包含一個 NAT 閘道。公司大多數的應用程式會讀取並寫入 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams。大多數的工作負載運行在私有子網中。一位解決方案架構師必須檢閱此基礎設施。架構師需要降低成本並維持應用程式的功能。架構師使用 Cost Explorer 時發現 EC2-Other 類別的成本持續偏高。進一步檢閱顯示，NatGateway-Bytes 的費用導致了 EC2-Other 類別成本的增加。解決方案架構師應該採取什麼行動來滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 啟用 VPC Flow Logs。使用 Amazon Athena 分析日誌以找出可以移除的流量。確保安全群組（Security Groups）封鎖導致高成本的流量。
B. 為 Kinesis Data Streams 新增一個介面 VPC 端點（Interface VPC Endpoint）到 VPC 中。確保應用程式擁有使用該介面 VPC 端點的正確 IAM 權限。
C. 啟用 VPC Flow Logs 與 Amazon Detective。檢閱 Detective 的發現結果，找出與 Kinesis Data Streams 無關的流量。設定安全群組以封鎖該流量。
D. 為 Kinesis Data Streams 新增一個介面 VPC 端點（Interface VPC Endpoint）到 VPC 中。確保 VPC 端點政策允許來自應用程式的流量。
解析(中):
本題的核心問題在於「NAT 閘道數據傳輸費用過高」。在 AWS 中，當私有子網中的資源（如 EC2 實例）需要存取公有服務（如 Kinesis Data Streams）時，流量會通過 NAT 閘道，這會產生數據處理費與數據傳輸費。

正確答案 D 的解析：
透過為 Kinesis Data Streams 建立介面 VPC 端點（Interface VPC Endpoint，基於 AWS PrivateLink），流量將直接在 AWS 內部網路中傳輸，而無需經過 NAT 閘道。這不僅能顯著降低 NAT 閘道的數據傳輸成本，還能提高網路安全性。設定 VPC 端點政策是確保應用程式能正確存取該端點的必要步驟。

其他選項不正確的原因：
A 與 C：VPC Flow Logs 僅用於監控與記錄流量，並不能改變流量路徑或降低 NAT 閘道的傳輸成本。使用安全群組封鎖流量可能會導致應用程式無法正常運作，且無法解決 Kinesis 數據傳輸產生的費用問題。
B：雖然新增介面 VPC 端點是正確的方向，但選項 B 強調的是「IAM 權限」，而選項 D 強調的是「VPC 端點政策」。在 AWS 架構實務中，若要控制誰能透過 VPC 端點存取服務，VPC 端點政策（Endpoint Policy）是標準的控制機制，且選項 D 的描述更符合架構設計的完整性要求。此外，IAM 權限通常是預設配置，而端點政策則是針對端點存取控制的關鍵設定。

題目(英):
A retail company has an on-premises data center in Europe. The company also has a multi-Region AWS presence that includes
the eu-west-1 and us-east-1 Regions. The company wants to be able to route network traffic from its on-premises infrastructure
into VPCs in either of those Regions. The company also needs to support traffic that is routed directly between VPCs in those
Regions. No single points of failure can exist on the network.
The company already has created two 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connections from its on-premises data center. Each
connection goes into a separate Direct Connect location in Europe for high availability. These two locations are named DX-A
and DX-B, respectively. Each Region has a single AWS Transit Gateway that is configured to route all inter-VPC traffic within
that Region.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Create a private VIF from the DX-A connection into a Direct Connect gateway. Create a private VIF from the DX-B
connection into the same Direct Connect gateway for high availability. Associate both the eu-west-1 and us-east-1 transit
gateways with the Direct Connect gateway. Peer the transit gateways with each other to support cross-Region routing.
B. Create a transit VIF from the DX-A connection into a Direct Connect gateway. Associate the eu-west-1 transit gateway
with this Direct Connect gateway. Create a transit VIF from the DX-8 connection into a separate Direct Connect gateway.
Associate the us-east-1 transit gateway with this separate Direct Connect gateway. Peer the Direct Connect gateways with
each other to support high availability and cross-Region routing.
C. Create a transit VIF from the DX-A connection into a Direct Connect gateway. Create a transit VIF from the DX-B
connection into the same Direct Connect gateway for high availability. Associate both the eu-west-1 and us-east-1 transit
gateways with this Direct Connect gateway. Configure the Direct Connect gateway to route traffic between the transit
gateways.
D. Create a transit VIF from the DX-A connection into a Direct Connect gateway. Create a transit VIF from the DX-B
connection into the same Direct Connect gateway for high availability. Associate both the eu-west-1 and us-east-1 transit
gateways with this Direct Connect gateway. Peer the transit gateways with each other to support cross-Region routing.
解析(英):
The core requirements of this question are: 1. Connection from the local end to multi-region VPC; 2. Traffic routing between cross-region VPC; 3. High availability (no single point of failure).

1. **Why D is the correct answer**:
   - Using **Transit VIF** is necessary to connect the local end to the AWS Transit Gateway (Private VIF cannot connect to the Transit Gateway).
   - Connecting both Direct Connect wires (DX-A and DX-B) to the same Direct Connect Gateway (DXGW) ensures high availability from the ground to AWS.
   - Associating the Transit Gateway (TGW) of both regions to the same DXGW enables routing from the ground to the multi-region VPC.
   - In order to achieve direct routing "between VPCs across regions", **Transit Gateway Peering** must be established between the Transit Gateways in the two regions. This is the standard way of handling cross-region VPC communication in the official AWS architecture.

2. **Why the other options are incorrect**:
   - **Option A**: The error is using "Private VIF". Private VIF can only connect to VPC or Direct Connect Gateway, but cannot route and exchange with Transit Gateway, so it cannot meet the requirement of connecting to TGW.
   - **Option B**: Although Transit VIF is used, connecting two TGWs to different DXGWs and performing DXGW Peering is not a standard architecture and adds unnecessary complexity. In addition, traffic routing between cross-region VPCs mainly relies on TGW Peering rather than DXGW Peering.
   - **Option C**: The Direct Connect Gateway itself is not responsible for routing traffic "between Transit Gateways". DXGW functions as a hub between the local end and the AWS network. Cross-region inter-VPC traffic must be processed through TGW Peering instead of routing by DXGW.
題目(中): 一家零售公司在歐洲擁有一個地端資料中心。該公司同時在 AWS 的 eu-west-1 和 us-east-1 區域設有資源。公司希望能夠將網路流量從其地端基礎設施路由到上述任一區域的 VPC 中。公司還需要支援在這些區域的 VPC 之間直接路由流量。網路不得存在單點故障。該公司已經從其地端資料中心建立了兩條 1 Gbps 的 AWS Direct Connect 連線。每條連線分別連接到歐洲不同的 Direct Connect 地點，以實現高可用性。這兩個地點分別命名為 DX-A 和 DX-B。每個區域都有一個 AWS Transit Gateway，用於路由該區域內的所有 VPC 間流量。請問哪種解決方案符合這些要求？
選項(中):
A. 從 DX-A 連線建立一個私有虛擬介面 (Private VIF) 到 Direct Connect Gateway。從 DX-B 連線建立一個私有虛擬介面到同一個 Direct Connect Gateway 以實現高可用性。將 eu-west-1 和 us-east-1 的 Transit Gateway 與該 Direct Connect Gateway 關聯。將這些 Transit Gateway 彼此進行對等互連 (Peering) 以支援跨區域路由。
B. 從 DX-A 連線建立一個傳輸虛擬介面 (Transit VIF) 到一個 Direct Connect Gateway。將 eu-west-1 的 Transit Gateway 與此 Direct Connect Gateway 關聯。從 DX-B 連線建立一個傳輸虛擬介面到另一個獨立的 Direct Connect Gateway。將 us-east-1 的 Transit Gateway 與此獨立的 Direct Connect Gateway 關聯。將這些 Direct Connect Gateway 彼此進行對等互連以支援高可用性和跨區域路由。
C. 從 DX-A 連線建立一個傳輸虛擬介面 (Transit VIF) 到一個 Direct Connect Gateway。從 DX-B 連線建立一個傳輸虛擬介面到同一個 Direct Connect Gateway 以實現高可用性。將 eu-west-1 和 us-east-1 的 Transit Gateway 與此 Direct Connect Gateway 關聯。設定 Direct Connect Gateway 以路由這些 Transit Gateway 之間的流量。
D. 從 DX-A 連線建立一個傳輸虛擬介面 (Transit VIF) 到一個 Direct Connect Gateway。從 DX-B 連線建立一個傳輸虛擬介面到同一個 Direct Connect Gateway 以實現高可用性。將 eu-west-1 和 us-east-1 的 Transit Gateway 與此 Direct Connect Gateway 關聯。將這些 Transit Gateway 彼此進行對等互連 (Peering) 以支援跨區域路由。
解析(中):
本題的核心需求在於：1. 地端到多區域 VPC 的連線；2. 跨區域 VPC 間的流量路由；3. 高可用性（無單點故障）。

1. **為何 D 是正確答案**：
   - 使用 **Transit VIF** 是將地端連接至 AWS Transit Gateway 的必要條件（Private VIF 無法連接 Transit Gateway）。
   - 將兩條 Direct Connect 連線（DX-A 與 DX-B）連接至同一個 Direct Connect Gateway (DXGW) 可確保地端到 AWS 的高可用性。
   - 將兩個區域的 Transit Gateway (TGW) 都關聯到同一個 DXGW，即可實現地端到多區域 VPC 的路由。
   - 為了實現「跨區域 VPC 間」的直接路由，必須在兩個區域的 Transit Gateway 之間建立 **Transit Gateway Peering**。這是 AWS 官方架構中處理跨區域 VPC 通訊的標準作法。

2. **為何其他選項不正確**：
   - **選項 A**：錯誤在於使用了「Private VIF」。Private VIF 僅能連接至 VPC 或 Direct Connect Gateway，但無法與 Transit Gateway 進行路由交換，因此無法達成連接 TGW 的需求。
   - **選項 B**：雖然使用了 Transit VIF，但將兩個 TGW 分別連接到不同的 DXGW 並進行 DXGW Peering 並非標準架構，且增加了不必要的複雜度。此外，跨區域 VPC 間的流量路由主要依賴 TGW Peering，而非 DXGW Peering。
   - **選項 C**：Direct Connect Gateway 本身並不負責路由「Transit Gateway 之間」的流量。DXGW 的功能是作為地端與 AWS 網路之間的樞紐，跨區域的 VPC 間流量必須透過 TGW Peering 來處理，而非由 DXGW 進行路由。

題目(英):
A company is running an application in the AWS Cloud. The company's security team must approve the creation of all new IAM
users. When a new IAM user is created, all access for the user must be removed automatically. The security team must then
receive a notification to approve the user. The company has a multi-Region AWS CloudTrail trail in the AWS account.
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule. Define a pattern with the detail-type value set to AWS
API Call via CloudTrail and an eventName of CreateUser.
B. Configure CloudTrail to send a notification for the CreateUser event to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon
SNS) topic.
C. Invoke a container that runs in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate technology to remove
access.
D. Invoke an AWS Step Functions state machine to remove access.
E. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to notify the security team. F. Use Amazon Pinpoint to notify the security team.
解析(英):
This question requires that the process be automatically triggered when an IAM user is created: remove permissions and notify the security team.

Correct option analysis:
- A: This is a critical step in triggering the automated process. Monitor CloudTrail's `CreateUser` API events through EventBridge to capture actions created by new users in real time.
- D: AWS Step Functions is the best choice for orchestrating automated workflows. When EventBridge captures an event, triggering the Step Functions state machine can reliably execute logic that removes user permissions (such as attaching a Deny policy).
- E: Amazon SNS is AWS's standard service for message push. It is suitable for sending notifications to the security team and meets the requirements of "notifying the security team" in the requirement.

Error option analysis:
- B: Although CloudTrail can send notifications, it cannot directly execute the logic of "automatically removing access permissions", and sending CloudTrail events directly to SNS does not have the ability to handle complex workflows (such as removing permissions).
- C: Although ECS Fargate can execute code, it is not a standard architecture for handling such event-driven workflows compared to Step Functions, and Step Functions is more suitable for managing such automated tasks that require state tracking.
- F: Amazon Pinpoint is mainly used for marketing activities, user engagement analysis and large-scale message push (such as push broadcasts and SMS). It is not a standard tool for the internal security team of the enterprise to receive system alerts. SNS is more suitable in this situation.
題目(中): 一家公司正在 AWS 雲端執行應用程式。公司的安全團隊必須核准所有新 IAM 使用者的建立。當建立新的 IAM 使用者時，該使用者的所有存取權限必須自動移除。隨後，安全團隊必須收到通知以核准該使用者。該公司在 AWS 帳戶中擁有一個多區域（multi-Region）的 AWS CloudTrail 追蹤（trail）。請問哪種步驟組合可以滿足這些需求？（選擇三項。）
選項(中):
A. 建立一個 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 規則。定義一個模式，將 detail-type 值設為 AWS API Call via CloudTrail，並將 eventName 設為 CreateUser。
B. 設定 CloudTrail，將 CreateUser 事件的通知發送到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主題。
C. 呼叫一個在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上以 AWS Fargate 技術執行的容器來移除存取權限。
D. 呼叫一個 AWS Step Functions 狀態機來移除存取權限。
E. 使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 來通知安全團隊。
F. 使用 Amazon Pinpoint 來通知安全團隊。
解析(中):
本題要求在 IAM 使用者建立時自動觸發流程：移除權限並通知安全團隊。

正確選項解析：
- A：這是觸發自動化流程的關鍵步驟。透過 EventBridge 監控 CloudTrail 的 `CreateUser` API 事件，可以即時捕捉到新使用者建立的動作。
- D：AWS Step Functions 是協調自動化工作流程的最佳選擇。當 EventBridge 捕捉到事件後，觸發 Step Functions 狀態機可以可靠地執行移除使用者權限（例如附加 Deny 政策）的邏輯。
- E：Amazon SNS 是 AWS 進行訊息推送的標準服務，適合用來發送通知給安全團隊，符合需求中「通知安全團隊」的要求。

錯誤選項解析：
- B：雖然 CloudTrail 可以發送通知，但它無法直接執行「自動移除存取權限」的邏輯，且直接將 CloudTrail 事件發送到 SNS 並不具備處理複雜工作流程（如移除權限）的能力。
- C：雖然 ECS Fargate 可以執行程式碼，但相較於 Step Functions，它並非處理此類事件驅動型工作流程的標準架構，且 Step Functions 更適合管理這種需要狀態追蹤的自動化任務。
- F：Amazon Pinpoint 主要用於行銷活動、用戶參與度分析及大規模訊息推送（如推播、簡訊），並非企業內部安全團隊接收系統告警的標準工具，SNS 在此情境下更為合適。

題目(英):
A company wants to migrate to AWS. The company wants to use a multi-account structure with centrally managed access to all
accounts and applications. The company also wants to keep the traffic on a private network. Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
is required at login, and specific roles are assigned to user groups.
The company must create separate accounts for development. staging, production, and shared network. The production
account and the shared network account must have connectivity to all accounts. The development account and the staging
account must have access only to each other.
Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take 10 meet these requirements? (Choose three.)
選項(英):
A. Deploy a landing zone environment by using AWS Control Tower. Enroll accounts and invite existing accounts into the
resulting organization in AWS Organizations.
B. Enable AWS Security Hub in all accounts to manage cross-account access. Collect findings through AWS CloudTrail to
force MFA login.
C. Create transit gateways and transit gateway VPC attachments in each account. Configure appropriate route tables.
D. Set up and enable AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Create appropriate permission sets with required MFA
for existing accounts.
E. Enable AWS Control Tower in all accounts to manage routing between accounts. Collect findings through AWS CloudTrail
to force MFA login.
F. Create IAM users and groups. Configure MFA for all users. Set up Amazon Cognoto user pools and Identity pools to
manage access to accounts and between accounts.
解析(英):
The correct answer is ACD, and the analysis is as follows:

A. Correct: AWS Control Tower is the best practice for establishing a multi-account architecture (Landing Zone). It can automatically set up AWS Organizations and provide centralized governance and compliance management, which meets the question's requirements for multi-account architecture and centralized management.

C. Correct: The question requires that production and shared network accounts need to be connected to all accounts, and development and test accounts need to be connected to each other, while keeping traffic on the private network. AWS Transit Gateway is a standard solution for connecting multiple VPCs and accounts. By configuring the routing table of Transit Gateway, you can accurately control the connection paths between VPCs to meet network isolation and connection requirements.

D. Correct: AWS IAM Identity Center (formerly AWS SSO) is AWS's recommended service for centrally managing multiple account access and user identities. It supports integration with existing identity sources and can define roles through "Permission Sets". It also natively supports MFA enforcement, fully meeting the question's requirements for identity access and MFA.

Analysis of wrong options:
B. Error: AWS Security Hub is primarily used for security compliance monitoring and threat detection, and is not a tool for managing cross-account access or enforcing MFA sign-ins.
E. Error: AWS Control Tower is used for governance and account lifecycle management. It is not responsible for managing network routing between VPCs; network routing should be handled by network services such as Transit Gateway or VPC Peering.
F. Error: IAM users and groups are typically used within a single account and are not suitable for centralized identity management across multiple accounts. Amazon Cognito is primarily used to authenticate users of applications (Apps) and is not used to manage cross-account access to the AWS Management Console.
題目(中): 一家公司想要遷移至 AWS。該公司希望使用多帳號架構，並對所有帳號與應用程式進行集中式的存取管理。公司同時希望將流量保持在私有網路中。登入時必須強制執行多因素驗證 (MFA)，並將特定角色分配給使用者群組。公司必須為開發、測試、生產及共享網路環境建立獨立的帳號。生產帳號與共享網路帳號必須能與所有帳號連線。開發帳號與測試帳號則僅能彼此存取。解決方案架構師應採取哪些步驟組合來滿足這些需求？（選擇三項。）
選項(中):
A. 使用 AWS Control Tower 部署登陸區 (Landing Zone) 環境。註冊帳號並將現有帳號邀請加入 AWS Organizations 中的組織。
B. 在所有帳號中啟用 AWS Security Hub 以管理跨帳號存取。透過 AWS CloudTrail 收集調查結果以強制執行 MFA 登入。
C. 在每個帳號中建立 Transit Gateway 與 Transit Gateway VPC 連接 (Attachments)。配置適當的路由表。
D. 設定並啟用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。為現有帳號建立具有必要 MFA 的適當權限集 (Permission Sets)。
E. 在所有帳號中啟用 AWS Control Tower 以管理帳號間的路由。透過 AWS CloudTrail 收集調查結果以強制執行 MFA 登入。
F. 建立 IAM 使用者與群組。為所有使用者配置 MFA。設定 Amazon Cognito 使用者池與識別池來管理對帳號的存取以及帳號間的存取。
解析(中):
正確答案為 ACD，解析如下：

A. 正確：AWS Control Tower 是建立多帳號架構（Landing Zone）的最佳實踐，它能自動化設定 AWS Organizations，並提供集中式的治理與合規性管理，符合題目對多帳號架構與集中管理的需求。

C. 正確：題目要求生產與共享網路帳號需與所有帳號連線，且開發與測試帳號需彼此連線，同時保持流量在私有網路中。AWS Transit Gateway 是連接多個 VPC 與帳號的標準解決方案，透過配置 Transit Gateway 的路由表，可以精確控制各 VPC 之間的連線路徑，滿足網路隔離與連線需求。

D. 正確：AWS IAM Identity Center (前身為 AWS SSO) 是 AWS 推薦用於集中管理多帳號存取與使用者身分的服務。它支援與現有身分來源整合，並可透過「權限集 (Permission Sets)」來定義角色，同時原生支援強制執行 MFA，完全符合題目對身分存取與 MFA 的需求。

錯誤選項分析：
B. 錯誤：AWS Security Hub 主要用於安全合規性監控與威脅偵測，並非用來管理跨帳號存取或強制執行 MFA 登入的工具。
E. 錯誤：AWS Control Tower 用於治理與帳號生命週期管理，它並不負責管理 VPC 之間的網路路由；網路路由應由 Transit Gateway 或 VPC Peering 等網路服務處理。
F. 錯誤：IAM 使用者與群組通常用於單一帳號內，不適合用於跨多帳號的集中式身分管理。Amazon Cognito 主要用於為應用程式（App）的使用者提供身分驗證，而非用於管理 AWS 管理控制台的跨帳號存取。

題目(英):
A company runs its application in the eu-west-1 Region and has one account for each of its environments: development,
testing, and production. All the environments are running 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by using stateful Amazon EC2
instances and Amazon RDS for MySQL databases. The databases are between 500 GB and 800 GB in size.
The development team and testing team work on business days during business hours, but the production environment
operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The company wants to reduce costs. All resources are tagged with an environment tag
with either development, testing, or production as the key.
What should a solutions architect do to reduce costs with the LEAST operational effort?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs once every day. Configure the rule to invoke one AWS Lambda function
that starts or slops instances based on me tag, day, and time.
B. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs every business day in the evening. Configure the rule to invoke an AWS
Lambda function that stops instances based on the tag. Create a second EventBridge rule that runs every business day in
the morning. Configure the second rule lo invoke another Lambda function that starts instances based on the tag.
C. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs every business day in the evening, Configure the rule to invoke an AWS
Lambda function that terminates, instances based on the lag. Create a second EventBridge rule that runs every business
day in the morning. Configure the second rule lo invoke another Lambda function that restores the instances from their last
backup based on the tag.
D. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs every hour. Configure the rule to invoke one AWS Lambda function that
terminates or restores instances from their last backup based on the tag. day, and time.
解析(英):
The core of this question is how to optimize costs for non-production environments (development and testing) with "the least operational burden".

Why the answer is B:
Option B uses the most standard and low-maintenance automated approach. EventBridge triggers Lambda functions regularly to "stop" and "start" EC2 execution instances. This ensures that the development and testing environments are shut down during non-working hours, thereby saving computing resource costs. Since EC2 execution entities are stateful, data will be retained in EBS after stopping, and work can be resumed by restarting. This is the simplest and lowest-risk operation method.

Why the other options are incorrect:
Option A: Although the logic is feasible, merging the start and stop logic into one function and relying on complex logical judgments (date, time, label) is more complex in maintenance and debugging than splitting start and stop into two clear rules.
Option C: This option recommends "terminating" the execution instance and restoring from backup. This will result in data loss (unless there is a complex synchronization mechanism), and the restoration process involves AMI creation, snapshot recovery and reconfiguration, which is extremely high operational burden and extremely unstable, and does not meet the requirements of "minimum operational burden".
Option D: This option also recommends "termination" and "restore". Not only is the operation burden huge, but executing it once an hour will lead to frequent resource changes, causing serious interference to the stability of the development and testing environment, and is extremely cost-effective.

Summary: For stateful EC2 execution individuals, the simplest cost optimization method is to use the scheduler (Scheduler) to start and stop instead of destroying and rebuilding.
題目(中): 一家公司在 eu-west-1 區域執行其應用程式，並為其每個環境（開發、測試和生產）各擁有一個帳號。所有環境皆使用具狀態（stateful）的 Amazon EC2 執行個體與 Amazon RDS for MySQL 資料庫，並維持 24 小時、每週 7 天運作。資料庫大小介於 500 GB 到 800 GB 之間。開發團隊與測試團隊僅在工作日的上班時間工作，但生產環境則需 24 小時、每週 7 天運作。該公司希望降低成本。所有資源皆已標記環境標籤（Environment tag），鍵值為 development、testing 或 production。解決方案架構師應採取什麼行動，以「最少的操作負擔」來降低成本？
選項(中):
A. 建立一個每天執行一次的 Amazon EventBridge 規則。設定該規則以觸發一個 AWS Lambda 函式，根據標籤、日期與時間來啟動或停止執行個體。
B. 建立一個在每個工作日晚上執行的 Amazon EventBridge 規則。設定該規則以觸發一個 AWS Lambda 函式，根據標籤停止執行個體。建立第二個在每個工作日早上執行的 EventBridge 規則。設定第二個規則以觸發另一個 AWS Lambda 函式，根據標籤啟動執行個體。
C. 建立一個在每個工作日晚上執行的 Amazon EventBridge 規則。設定該規則以觸發一個 AWS Lambda 函式，根據標籤終止執行個體。建立第二個在每個工作日早上執行的 EventBridge 規則。設定第二個規則以觸發另一個 AWS Lambda 函式，根據標籤從最後一次備份還原執行個體。
D. 建立一個每小時執行一次的 Amazon EventBridge 規則。設定該規則以觸發一個 AWS Lambda 函式，根據標籤、日期與時間來終止或從最後一次備份還原執行個體。
解析(中):
本題的核心在於如何在「最少的操作負擔」下，針對非生產環境（開發與測試）進行成本優化。

為什麼答案是 B：
選項 B 採用了最標準且低維護成本的自動化方式。透過 EventBridge 定時觸發 Lambda 函式來「停止」與「啟動」EC2 執行個體，這能確保開發與測試環境在非工作時間關閉，從而節省計算資源費用。由於 EC2 執行個體是具狀態的（stateful），停止後資料會保留在 EBS 中，重新啟動即可恢復工作，這是最簡單且風險最低的操作方式。

為什麼其他選項不正確：
選項 A：雖然邏輯可行，但將啟動與停止邏輯合併在一個函式中，並依賴複雜的邏輯判斷（日期、時間、標籤），在維護與除錯上的複雜度高於將啟動與停止拆分為兩個明確的規則。
選項 C：此選項建議「終止（terminate）」執行個體並從備份還原。這會導致資料遺失（除非有複雜的同步機制），且還原過程涉及 AMI 建立、快照恢復與重新配置，操作負擔極高且極不穩定，不符合「最少操作負擔」的要求。
選項 D：此選項同樣建議「終止」與「還原」，不僅操作負擔極大，且每小時執行一次會導致頻繁的資源變動，對開發與測試環境的穩定性造成嚴重干擾，且成本效益極低。

總結：對於具狀態的 EC2 執行個體，最簡單的成本優化手段就是利用排程器（Scheduler）進行啟動與停止，而非銷毀與重建。

題目(英):
A company is building a software-as-a-service (SaaS) solution on AWS. The company has deployed an Amazon API Gateway
REST API with AWS Lambda integration in multiple AWS Regions and in the same production account.
The company offers tiered pricing that gives customers the ability to pay for the capacity to make a certain number of API calls
per second. The premium tier offers up to 3,000 calls per second, and customers are identified by a unique API key. Several
premium tier customers in various Regions report that they receive error responses of 429 Too Many Requests from multiple
API methods during peak usage hours. Logs indicate that the Lambda function is never invoked.
What could be the cause of the error messages for these customers?
選項(英):
A. The Lambda function reached its concurrency limit.
B. The Lambda function its Region limit for concurrency.
C. The company reached its API Gateway account limit for calls per second.
D. The company reached its API Gateway default per-method limit for calls per second.
解析(英):
The correct answer is C. Here’s why:
1. **Why C is correct**: API Gateway has account-level throttling. By default, the steady-state request rate of each account in each region is limited to 10,000 requests per second. When the total number of requests across multiple regions or multiple APIs exceeds this account-level limit, API Gateway rejects the request and returns a 429 error. Since the title mentioned "The log shows that the Lambda function was never triggered", this means that the request was intercepted and rejected by API Gateway before reaching Lambda, which is consistent with the behavior of account-level restrictions.

2. **Why A and B are wrong**: If Lambda reaches the concurrency limit (Concurrency limit), API Gateway will still receive the request and try to trigger Lambda. At this point API Gateway will receive an error from Lambda and return a 429 or 503 error. However, the title clearly states that "the log shows that the Lambda function was never triggered", which excludes the problem caused by Lambda's concurrency limit.

3. **Why D is wrong**: Although API Gateway does have a limit for each method (Per-method), the question describes "multiple API methods" when errors occur at the same time, and the company provides a capacity of up to 3,000 calls for premium customers. If it is just a limitation of a single method, it usually does not cause such problems to occur across multiple methods and in multiple areas at the same time. Account-level restrictions (option C) are global restrictions that affect all APIs for the entire account and best explain why multiple methods fail at the same time and the Lambda is not triggered.
題目(中): 一家公司正在 AWS 上建構軟體即服務 (SaaS) 解決方案。該公司在同一個生產帳戶的多個 AWS 區域中部署了具有 AWS Lambda 整合的 Amazon API Gateway REST API。該公司提供分級定價，讓客戶能夠付費購買每秒特定數量的 API 呼叫容量。高級方案提供每秒高達 3,000 次呼叫，且客戶透過唯一的 API 金鑰進行識別。多個區域中的幾位高級方案客戶回報，在尖峰使用時段，他們從多個 API 方法收到 429 Too Many Requests（請求過多）的錯誤回應。日誌顯示 Lambda 函數從未被觸發。請問這些客戶收到錯誤訊息的原因可能為何？
選項(中):
A. Lambda 函數達到了其並發限制。
B. Lambda 函數達到了其區域的並發限制。
C. 該公司達到了其 API Gateway 帳戶層級的每秒呼叫次數限制。
D. 該公司達到了其 API Gateway 預設的每個方法每秒呼叫次數限制。
解析(中):
正確答案是 C。原因如下：
1. **為什麼 C 是正確的**：API Gateway 具有帳戶層級的限制（Account-level throttling），預設情況下，每個帳戶在每個區域的穩定狀態請求速率限制為每秒 10,000 次請求。當多個區域或多個 API 的總請求量超過此帳戶層級限制時，API Gateway 會拒絕請求並回傳 429 錯誤。由於題目提到「日誌顯示 Lambda 函數從未被觸發」，這表示請求在到達 Lambda 之前就被 API Gateway 攔截並拒絕了，這符合帳戶層級限制的行為。

2. **為什麼 A 和 B 是錯誤的**：如果 Lambda 達到並發限制（Concurrency limit），API Gateway 仍然會接收到請求，並嘗試觸發 Lambda。此時 API Gateway 會收到來自 Lambda 的錯誤，並回傳 429 或 503 錯誤。然而，題目明確指出「日誌顯示 Lambda 函數從未被觸發」，這排除了 Lambda 並發限制導致的問題。

3. **為什麼 D 是錯誤的**：雖然 API Gateway 確實有針對每個方法（Per-method）的限制，但題目描述的是「多個 API 方法」同時出現錯誤，且該公司針對高級客戶提供高達 3,000 次呼叫的容量。如果只是單一方法的限制，通常不會導致跨多個方法且在多個區域同時出現此類問題。帳戶層級限制（選項 C）是影響整個帳戶所有 API 的全域性限制，最能解釋為何多個方法同時失效且 Lambda 未被觸發的情況。

題目(英):
A financial company is planning to migrate its web application from on premises to AWS. The company uses a third-party
security tool to monitor the inbound traffic to the application. The company has used the security tool for the last 15 years, and
the tool has no cloud solutions available from its vendor. The company's security team is concerned about how to integrate the
security tool with AWS technology.
The company plans to deploy the application migration to AWS on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances will run in an
Auto Scaling group in a dedicated VPC. The company needs to use the security tool to inspect all packets that come in and out
of the VPC. This inspection must occur in real time and must not affect the application's performance. A solutions architect
must design a target architecture on AWS that is highly available within an AWS Region.
Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Deploy the security tool on EC2 instances m a new Auto Scaling group in the existing VPC
B. Deploy the web application behind a Network Load Balancer
C. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in front of the security tool instances
D. Provision a Gateway Load Balancer for each Availability Zone to redirect the traffic to the security tool
E. Provision a transit gateway to facilitate communication between VPCs.
解析(英):
The core requirement of this question is to integrate third-party security tools (virtual appliances) into the AWS architecture to inspect all traffic in and out of the VPC. It must be highly available, real-time, and avoid affecting application performance.

The correct answer is AD for the following reasons:
- **Option D (Gateway Load Balancer, GWLB)**: GWLB is a service designed for deploying third-party virtual devices (such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems). It transparently intercepts traffic and forwards it to security devices for inspection and is highly available. Deploying GWLB in each Availability Zone (AZ) ensures that traffic is directed to security tools immediately as it enters or leaves the VPC without significantly impacting application performance.
- **Option A**: Since this security tool does not have a cloud-native solution, it must be deployed on EC2 instances. To ensure high availability and handle loads that fluctuate with traffic, deploying these security tools in Auto Scaling groups ensures that security inspection capabilities are automatically scaled as traffic increases.

Why the other options are incorrect:
- **Option B**: While NLB can handle traffic, it cannot perform deep packet inspection (DPI) itself or direct traffic to third-party security tools for inspection, so it is not sufficient.
- **Option C**: Application Load Balancer (ALB) works at OSI layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS), it cannot handle all types of packet inspection, and placing it in front of security tools is not standard practice for architecting traffic inspection.
- **Option E**: Transit Gateway is mainly used to connect multiple VPCs or local networks. Although it can be used with GWLB, simply configuring Transit Gateway cannot solve the core problem of "how to direct traffic to third-party security tools for real-time inspection."
題目(中):
一家金融公司正計劃將其網頁應用程式從地端遷移至 AWS。該公司使用第三方安全工具來監控應用程式的入站流量。該公司過去 15 年來一直使用此安全工具，且該供應商並未提供任何雲端解決方案。公司的安全團隊對於如何將此安全工具與 AWS 技術整合感到擔憂。
公司計劃將應用程式遷移部署至 AWS 的 Amazon EC2 實例上。這些 EC2 實例將在專用 VPC 中的 Auto Scaling 群組內執行。公司需要使用該安全工具來檢查進出 VPC 的所有封包。此檢查必須即時進行，且不得影響應用程式的效能。解決方案架構師必須在 AWS 區域內設計一個具備高可用性的目標架構。
解決方案架構師應採取哪種步驟組合來滿足這些需求？（選擇兩項。）
選項(中):
A. 在現有 VPC 的新 Auto Scaling 群組中部署安全工具的 EC2 實例
B. 將網頁應用程式部署在網路負載平衡器（Network Load Balancer）後方
C. 在安全工具實例前方部署應用程式負載平衡器（Application Load Balancer）
D. 為每個可用區域（Availability Zone）配置一個閘道負載平衡器（Gateway Load Balancer），以將流量重新導向至安全工具
E. 配置傳輸閘道（Transit Gateway）以促進 VPC 之間的通訊
解析(中):
本題的核心需求是將第三方安全工具（虛擬設備）整合進 AWS 架構中，以檢查進出 VPC 的所有流量，且必須具備高可用性、即時性，並避免影響應用程式效能。

正確答案為 AD，原因如下：
- **選項 D (Gateway Load Balancer, GWLB)**：GWLB 是專為部署第三方虛擬設備（如防火牆、入侵偵測系統）而設計的服務。它能以透明的方式攔截流量並將其轉發至安全設備進行檢查，且具備高可用性。在每個可用區域（AZ）部署 GWLB，可以確保流量在進入或離開 VPC 時被即時導向至安全工具，且不會對應用程式效能造成顯著影響。
- **選項 A**：由於該安全工具沒有雲端原生解決方案，必須將其部署在 EC2 實例上。為了確保高可用性並能處理隨流量變動的負載，將這些安全工具部署在 Auto Scaling 群組中是正確的做法，這能確保在流量增加時自動擴展安全檢查能力。

其他選項為何不正確：
- **選項 B**：雖然 NLB 可以處理流量，但它本身無法執行深度封包檢查（DPI），也無法將流量導向至第三方安全工具進行檢查，因此無法滿足需求。
- **選項 C**：應用程式負載平衡器（ALB）工作在 OSI 第 7 層（HTTP/HTTPS），它無法處理所有類型的封包檢查，且將其放在安全工具前方並非架構流量檢查的標準做法。
- **選項 E**：Transit Gateway 主要用於連接多個 VPC 或地端網路，雖然它可以與 GWLB 搭配使用，但單純配置 Transit Gateway 並不能解決「如何將流量導向至第三方安全工具進行即時檢查」的核心問題。

題目(英):
A company has purchased appliances from different vendors. The appliances all have IoT sensors. The sensors send status
information in the vendors' proprietary formats to a legacy application that parses the information into JSON. The parsing is
simple, but each vendor has a unique format. Once daily, the application parses all the JSON records and stores the records in
a relational database for analysis.
The company needs to design a new data analysis solution that can deliver faster and optimize costs.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
選項(英):
A. Connect the IoT sensors to AWS IoT Core. Set a rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to parse the information and
save a .csv file to Amazon. S3 Use AWS Glue to catalog the files. Use Amazon Athena and Amazon QuickSight for analysis.
B. Migrate the application server to AWS Fargate, which will receive the information from IoT sensors and parse the
information into a relational format. Save the parsed information to Amazon Redshlft for analysis.
C. Create an AWS Transfer for SFTP server. Update the IoT sensor code to send the information as a .csv file through SFTP
to the server. Use AWS Glue to catalog the files. Use Amazon Athena for analysis.
D. Use AWS Snowball Edge to collect data from the IoT sensors directly to perform local analysis. Periodically collect the
data into Amazon Redshift to perform global analysis.
解析(英):
Answer A is correct for the following reasons:
1. **Architecture Optimization**: Use AWS IoT Core to efficiently handle IoT device connections from different vendors. AWS Lambda is triggered through the IoT Rules Engine for real-time analysis, replacing the old model of daily batch processing, which greatly improves the speed and immediacy of data processing.
2. **Cost Effectiveness**: Storing data in Amazon S3 (object storage) is more cost effective than maintaining a continuously running relational database. Amazon Athena uses on-demand query (Serverless) and only pays when executing the query, further optimizing costs.
3. **Analysis capabilities**: AWS Glue provides a data catalog function that allows Athena to easily query data in S3 and perform visual analysis through QuickSight. This is a modern and highly scalable architecture.

Reasons why other options are incorrect:
- Option B: Although migrating the application to Fargate is a modernization approach, it still requires maintaining the application logic and storing data in Redshift. For simple parsing tasks, the cost is too high and the architecture is too complex to achieve optimal cost optimization.
- Option C: Requiring code updates for all IoT sensors to support the SFTP protocol is often not feasible in practice (hardware limitations or vendor limitations), and SFTP is not the best architecture for handling IoT real-time streaming data.
- Option D: AWS Snowball Edge is mainly used for large-scale data migration or edge computing. It is not suitable for processing continuous IoT sensor data streaming, and this solution cannot meet the "faster" analysis requirements because it involves cumbersome physical data collection and transmission processes.
題目(中): 一家公司向不同的供應商購買了設備，這些設備都配備了 IoT 感測器。感測器會以供應商各自的專有格式發送狀態資訊給一個舊有的應用程式，該程式會將資訊解析為 JSON 格式。解析過程很簡單，但每家供應商的格式都不同。該應用程式每天執行一次，將所有的 JSON 記錄解析並儲存到關聯式資料庫中以進行分析。公司需要設計一個新的資料分析解決方案，以提供更快的速度並優化成本。哪一個解決方案能滿足這些需求？
選項(中):
A. 將 IoT 感測器連接到 AWS IoT Core。設定規則以觸發 AWS Lambda 函式來解析資訊，並將 .csv 檔案儲存到 Amazon S3。使用 AWS Glue 對檔案進行編目。使用 Amazon Athena 和 Amazon QuickSight 進行分析。
B. 將應用程式伺服器遷移到 AWS Fargate，由其接收來自 IoT 感測器的資訊並將其解析為關聯式格式。將解析後的資訊儲存到 Amazon Redshift 以進行分析。
C. 建立一個 AWS Transfer for SFTP 伺服器。更新 IoT 感測器程式碼，使其透過 SFTP 將資訊以 .csv 檔案形式傳送到伺服器。使用 AWS Glue 對檔案進行編目。使用 Amazon Athena 進行分析。
D. 使用 AWS Snowball Edge 直接從 IoT 感測器收集資料以進行本地分析。定期將資料收集到 Amazon Redshift 以進行全域分析。
解析(中):
答案 A 是正確的，原因如下：
1. **架構優化**：使用 AWS IoT Core 可以高效地處理來自不同供應商的 IoT 裝置連線。透過 IoT Rules Engine 觸發 AWS Lambda 進行即時解析，取代了原本每日批次處理的舊有模式，大幅提升了資料處理的速度與即時性。
2. **成本效益**：將資料儲存於 Amazon S3（物件儲存）比維護一個持續運行的關聯式資料庫更具成本效益。Amazon Athena 採用隨選查詢（Serverless），僅在執行查詢時付費，進一步優化了成本。
3. **分析能力**：AWS Glue 提供了資料目錄（Data Catalog）功能，讓 Athena 可以輕鬆查詢 S3 中的資料，並透過 QuickSight 進行視覺化分析，這是一個現代化且具備高度擴充性的架構。

其他選項不正確的原因：
- 選項 B：將應用程式遷移至 Fargate 雖然是現代化手段，但仍需維護應用程式邏輯，且將資料存入 Redshift 對於簡單的解析任務來說，成本過高且架構過於複雜，無法達到最佳的成本優化。
- 選項 C：要求更新所有 IoT 感測器的程式碼以支援 SFTP 協定在實務上通常不可行（硬體限制或供應商限制），且 SFTP 並非處理 IoT 即時串流資料的最佳架構。
- 選項 D：AWS Snowball Edge 主要用於大規模資料遷移或邊緣運算，並不適合用於處理持續性的 IoT 感測器資料串流，且該方案無法滿足「更快速」的分析需求，因為它涉及了繁瑣的物理資料收集與傳輸過程。

題目(英):
A company is migrating some of its applications to AWS. The company wants to migrate and modernize the applications
quickly after it finalizes networking and security strategies. The company has set up an AWS Direct Connect connection in a
central network account.
The company expects to have hundreds of AWS accounts and VPCs in the near future. The corporate network must be able to
access the resources on AWS seamlessly and also must be able to communicate with all the VPCs. The company also wants to
route its cloud resources to the internet through its on-premises data center.
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)
選項(英):
A. Create a Direct Connect gateway in the central account. In each of the accounts, create an association proposal by using
the Direct Connect gateway and the account ID for every virtual private gateway.
B. Create a Direct Connect gateway and a transit gateway in the central network account. Attach the transit gateway to the
Direct Connect gateway by using a transit VIF.
C. Provision an internet gateway. Attach the internet gateway to subnets. Allow internet traffic through the gateway.
D. Share the transit gateway with other accounts. Attach VPCs to the transit gateway.
E. Provision VPC peering as necessary.
F. Provision only private subnets. Open the necessary route on the transit gateway and customer gateway to allow
outbound internet traffic from AWS to flow through NAT services that run in the data center.
解析(英):
The core requirement of this question is to handle a large-scale multi-account architecture (hundreds of VPCs) and require all VPCs to be connected to the local network and to direct Internet traffic back to the local network.

The correct answers are B, D, and F (Note: The question requires you to choose three items. According to AWS architecture best practices, the correct combination should be B, D, and F. If the answer given in the question is BD, it may be a simplified option. The following explains why B, D, and F are the correct combination):

1. **Option B (Correct)**: Using Transit Gateway (TGW) with Direct Connect Gateway is a standard architecture for connecting multiple VPCs to local networks. Connecting the TGW to the Direct Connect Gateway via Transit VIF enables efficient route management, which is key when handling hundreds of VPCs.
2. **Option D (Correct)**: Sharing a Transit Gateway through AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) allows VPCs in other accounts to connect to the same central hub, which is a necessary step for achieving connectivity in a multi-account architecture.
3. **Option F (Correct)**: The question clearly requires "routing Internet traffic of cloud resources through an on-premises data center." This means that AWS's native Internet Gateway (IGW) cannot be used. Instead, traffic must be directed to the local end through a TGW, and the traffic must be handled by the local NAT or firewall.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**
* **Option A**: Direct Connect Gateway Directly associated VGW is suitable for smaller scale architectures, but with hundreds of VPCs, managing route tables for hundreds of VGWs becomes extremely complex and difficult to maintain, so it is not suitable.
* **Option C**: The question requires that traffic must pass through the local data center. If IGW is configured, the traffic will directly enter the Internet from the VPC, which violates the requirement of "routing through the local data center".
* **Option E**: VPC Peering belongs to a mesh topology (Mesh). In an environment with hundreds of VPCs, the number of connections will grow exponentially (n*(n-1)/2). The management cost is too high and it is not scalable, which does not meet the needs of modern architecture.

題目(英):
A company has hundreds of AWS accounts. The company recently implemented a centralized internal process for purchasing
new Reserved Instances and modifying existing Reserved Instances. This process requires all business units that want to
purchase or modify Reserved Instances to submit requests to a dedicated team for procurement. Previously, business units
directly purchased or modified Reserved Instances in their own respective AWS accounts autonomously.
A solutions architect needs to enforce the new process in the most secure way possible.
Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
選項(英):
A. Ensure that all AWS accounts are part of an organization in AWS Organizations with all features enabled.
B. Use AWS Config to report on the attachment of an IAM policy that denies access to the
ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering action and the ec2:ModifyReservedInstances action.
C. In each AWS account, create an IAM policy that denies the ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering action and the
ec2:ModifyReservedInstances action.
D. Create an SCP that denies the ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering action and the ec2:ModifyReservedInstances
action. Attach the SCP to each OU of the organization.
E. Ensure that all AWS accounts are part of an organization in AWS Organizations that uses the consolidated billing
feature.
解析(英):
The most effective and secure way to enforce centralized governance across multiple accounts is to use AWS Organizations' Service Control Policies (SCPs).

Why the answer is AD:
- A: To use SCP to limit account permissions, "All Features" must be enabled in AWS Organizations. SCP cannot be enabled using only the consolidated billing feature (option E).
- D: SCP is a mechanism that defines the boundaries of the highest authority of accounts within an organization. By creating an SCP that denies purchase and modification RI actions and applying it to the organizational unit (OU), you can ensure that even account administrators cannot bypass this restriction, thereby enforcing a centralized purchasing process.

Why the other options are incorrect:
- B: AWS Config can only be used to "detect" and "report" compliance, and cannot actively "prevent" or "enforce" permission restrictions. This does not comply with the mandatory execution process required by the question.
- C: While establishing IAM policies in each account can limit permissions, this approach is difficult to manage and not enforceable. Account administrators can modify or delete these IAM policies at any time, so the security and consistency of the process cannot be ensured.
- E: The consolidated billing feature is only used for billing consolidation and does not have the "All Features" permissions required to enable SCP, so it cannot achieve the purpose of enforcing permission restrictions.
題目(中): 一家公司擁有數百個 AWS 帳號。該公司最近實施了一項集中的內部流程，用於購買新的預留執行個體（Reserved Instances, RI）並修改現有的預留執行個體。此流程要求所有希望購買或修改預留執行個體的業務單位，必須向專門的採購團隊提交申請。在此之前，各業務單位是在各自的 AWS 帳號中自主購買或修改預留執行個體。解決方案架構師需要以最安全的方式強制執行此新流程。架構師應採取哪兩種步驟來滿足這些需求？（選擇兩項。）
選項(中):
A. 確保所有 AWS 帳號皆屬於 AWS Organizations 中的一個組織，並啟用所有功能（All Features）。
B. 使用 AWS Config 來報告 IAM 政策的附加情況，該政策拒絕 ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering 和 ec2:ModifyReservedInstances 動作。
C. 在每個 AWS 帳號中，建立一個 IAM 政策以拒絕 ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering 和 ec2:ModifyReservedInstances 動作。
D. 建立一個服務控制政策（SCP），拒絕 ec2:PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering 和 ec2:ModifyReservedInstances 動作。將此 SCP 附加到組織的每個組織單位（OU）。
E. 確保所有 AWS 帳號皆屬於 AWS Organizations 中的一個組織，並使用合併帳單（Consolidated Billing）功能。
解析(中):
要強制執行跨多個帳號的集中式治理，最有效且安全的方法是使用 AWS Organizations 的服務控制政策（SCP）。

為什麼答案是 AD：
- A：要使用 SCP 來限制帳號權限，必須在 AWS Organizations 中啟用「所有功能（All Features）」。僅使用合併帳單功能（選項 E）無法啟用 SCP。
- D：SCP 是定義組織內帳號最高權限邊界的機制。透過建立一個拒絕購買與修改 RI 動作的 SCP 並將其套用到組織單位（OU），可以確保即使是帳號管理員也無法繞過此限制，從而強制執行集中採購流程。

為什麼其他選項不正確：
- B：AWS Config 僅能用於「偵測」與「報告」合規性，無法主動「防止」或「強制執行」權限限制。這不符合題目要求的強制執行流程。
- C：雖然在每個帳號中建立 IAM 政策可以限制權限，但這種方式難以管理且不具備強制性。帳號管理員可以隨時修改或刪除這些 IAM 政策，因此無法確保流程的安全性與一致性。
- E：合併帳單功能僅用於帳單整合，並不具備啟用 SCP 所需的「所有功能」權限，因此無法達成強制執行權限限制的目的。

題目(英):
A company is running a critical application that uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL database to store data. The RDS DB instance
is deployed in Multi-AZ mode.
A recent RDS database failover test caused a 40-second outage to the application. A solutions architect needs to design a
solution to reduce the outage time to less than 20 seconds.
Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)
選項(英):
A. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached in front of the database
B. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis in front of the database
C. Use RDS Proxy in front of the database.
D. Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL.
E. Create an Amazon Aurora Replica. F. Create an RDS for MySQL read replica
解析(英):
To reduce the fault-tolerance migration time of RDS for MySQL to less than 20 seconds, the connection management and database engine features must be optimized:

1. **Option C (RDS Proxy) Correct**: RDS Proxy reduces the time it takes for applications to re-establish connections during a fault-tolerant migration by maintaining a pool of pre-created database connections. When a database failover occurs, RDS Proxy will automatically redirect application connections to the new database execution instance, significantly reducing the downtime perceived by the application.

2. **Option D (Migrate to Aurora MySQL) Correct**: Amazon Aurora is designed for the cloud, and its architecture separates storage and computing. Compared with traditional RDS for MySQL, Aurora's fault-tolerant migration mechanism is faster and can usually be completed within 30 seconds. With appropriate application settings, it is easy to achieve the goal of within 20 seconds.

3. **Option E (Create Aurora Replica) Correct**: In the Aurora architecture, Aurora read-only replicas (Read Replicas) share the same underlying storage space as the main execution instance. When the primary execution instance fails, one of the Aurora read-only replicas will be promoted to the new primary execution instance. This process is very fast and is a key component to achieve low-latency fault-tolerant migration.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**
* **Options A and B**: Although ElastiCache can cache data to reduce database load, it cannot solve the fault-tolerant migration mechanism and connection interruption problems of the database engine itself, so it cannot directly shorten the failover time at the database level.
* **Option F**: The Read Replica of RDS for MySQL operates through asynchronous replication and has independent storage space from the main execution instance. Promoting it to the main execution instance requires a long process and cannot provide fast automatic fault-tolerant migration capabilities like Aurora, so it cannot meet the goal of less than 20 seconds.
題目(中): 一家公司正在執行一個關鍵應用程式，該應用程式使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL 資料庫來儲存資料。此 RDS 資料庫執行個體部署在多可用區（Multi-AZ）模式。最近的一次 RDS 資料庫容錯移轉（failover）測試導致應用程式中斷了 40 秒。解決方案架構師需要設計一個解決方案，將中斷時間縮短至 20 秒以內。解決方案架構師應該採取哪些步驟組合來滿足這些需求？（選擇三項。）
選項(中):
A. 在資料庫前端使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached
B. 在資料庫前端使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis
C. 在資料庫前端使用 RDS Proxy
D. 將資料庫遷移至 Amazon Aurora MySQL
E. 建立一個 Amazon Aurora 唯讀複本（Aurora Replica）
F. 建立一個 RDS for MySQL 唯讀複本（Read Replica）
解析(中):
要將 RDS for MySQL 的容錯移轉時間縮短至 20 秒以內，必須針對連線管理與資料庫引擎特性進行優化：

1. **選項 C (RDS Proxy) 正確**：RDS Proxy 透過維護一個預先建立的資料庫連線池，減少了應用程式在容錯移轉期間重新建立連線的時間。當資料庫發生故障切換時，RDS Proxy 會自動將應用程式連線重新導向至新的資料庫執行個體，大幅降低了應用程式感知到的停機時間。

2. **選項 D (遷移至 Aurora MySQL) 正確**：Amazon Aurora 專為雲端設計，其架構將儲存與運算分離。相比傳統的 RDS for MySQL，Aurora 的容錯移轉機制更為迅速，通常能在 30 秒內完成，配合適當的應用程式設定，極易達到 20 秒以內的目標。

3. **選項 E (建立 Aurora Replica) 正確**：在 Aurora 架構中，Aurora 唯讀複本（Read Replicas）與主執行個體共享相同的底層儲存空間。當主執行個體發生故障時，其中一個 Aurora 唯讀複本會被提升為新的主執行個體，這個過程非常快速，是實現低延遲容錯移轉的關鍵組成部分。

**為何其他選項不正確：**
* **選項 A 與 B**：雖然 ElastiCache 可以快取資料以減輕資料庫負載，但它無法解決資料庫引擎本身的容錯移轉機制與連線中斷問題，因此無法直接縮短資料庫層級的故障切換時間。
* **選項 F**：RDS for MySQL 的唯讀複本（Read Replica）是透過非同步複製運作的，且與主執行個體擁有獨立的儲存空間。將其提升為主執行個體需要較長的程序，無法像 Aurora 那樣提供快速的自動容錯移轉能力，因此無法滿足 20 秒以內的目標。

題目(英):
An AWS partner company is building a service in AWS Organizations using its organization named org1. This service requires
the partner company to have access to AWS resources in a customer account, which is in a separate organization named org2.
The company must establish least privilege security access using an API or command line tool to the customer account.
What is the MOST secure way to allow org1 to access resources in org2?
選項(英):
A. The customer should provide the partner company with their AWS account access keys to log in and perform the required
tasks.
B. The customer should create an IAM user and assign the required permissions to the IAM user. The customer should then
provide the credentials to the partner company to log in and perform the required tasks.
C. The customer should create an IAM role and assign the required permissions to the IAM role. The partner company
should then use the IAM role’s Amazon Resource Name (ARN) when requesting access to perform the required tasks.
D. The customer should create an IAM role and assign the required permissions to the IAM role. The partner company
should then use the IAM role’s Amazon Resource Name (ARN), including the external ID in the IAM role’s trust policy, when
requesting access to perform the required tasks.
解析(英):
The correct answer is D. In cross-account access scenarios, using IAM roles is a best practice recommended by AWS because it does not require sharing long-term credentials (such as access keys). Option D is the most secure because it incorporates the "External ID" mechanism. The external ID is designed to prevent the "Confused Deputy Problem". When a third party (partner) accesses resources on behalf of multiple customers, the external ID can ensure that only the partner with the correct ID can access the customer's resources. This is the highest security requirement in a multi-tenant environment.

Analysis of other options:
A and B: These options involve sharing long-term credentials (access keys or IAM user passwords), which violates security best practices because the credentials are difficult to revoke if compromised and do not comply with the principle of least privilege.
C: Although using an IAM role is more secure than sharing credentials, it lacks an "external ID". Without an external ID, the role may be at risk of an obfuscated agent attack, where another entity possessing the role's ARN may attempt to access the account. Therefore, option D is more rigorous and complete in terms of security architecture than option C.
題目(中): 一家 AWS 合作夥伴公司正在使用名為 org1 的組織在 AWS Organizations 中建立一項服務。此服務要求該合作夥伴公司能夠存取位於另一個名為 org2 的組織中的客戶帳戶內的 AWS 資源。該公司必須使用 API 或命令列工具，以「最小權限原則」建立對客戶帳戶的安全存取。請問允許 org1 存取 org2 中資源的最安全方式是什麼？
選項(中):
A. 客戶應將其 AWS 帳戶存取金鑰提供給合作夥伴公司，以便其登入並執行所需任務。
B. 客戶應建立一個 IAM 使用者並指派所需的權限給該使用者，然後將憑證提供給合作夥伴公司以登入並執行所需任務。
C. 客戶應建立一個 IAM 角色並指派所需的權限給該角色，合作夥伴公司在請求存取以執行任務時，應使用該 IAM 角色的 Amazon Resource Name (ARN)。
D. 客戶應建立一個 IAM 角色並指派所需的權限給該角色，合作夥伴公司在請求存取以執行任務時，應使用該 IAM 角色的 Amazon Resource Name (ARN)，並在 IAM 角色的信任政策中包含外部 ID (External ID)。
解析(中):
正確答案是 D。在跨帳戶存取的情境中，使用 IAM 角色（Role）是 AWS 推薦的最佳實踐，因為它不需要分享長期憑證（如存取金鑰）。選項 D 之所以最安全，是因為它加入了「外部 ID (External ID)」機制。外部 ID 是為了防止「混淆代理人問題 (Confused Deputy Problem)」而設計的，當第三方（合作夥伴）代表多個客戶存取資源時，外部 ID 能確保只有擁有正確 ID 的合作夥伴才能存取該客戶的資源，這在多租戶環境中是安全性最高的要求。

其他選項分析：
A 與 B：這些選項涉及分享長期憑證（存取金鑰或 IAM 使用者密碼），這違反了安全性最佳實踐，因為憑證一旦外洩將難以撤銷，且不符合最小權限原則。
C：雖然使用 IAM 角色比分享憑證安全，但它缺少了「外部 ID」。若沒有外部 ID，該角色可能面臨混淆代理人攻擊的風險，即其他擁有該角色 ARN 的實體可能嘗試存取該帳戶。因此，D 選項在安全性架構上比 C 更為嚴謹且完整。

題目(英):
A delivery company needs to migrate its third-party route planning application to AWS. The third party supplies a supported
Docker image from a public registry. The image can run in as many containers as required to generate the route map.
The company has divided the delivery area into sections with supply hubs so that delivery drivers travel the shortest distance
possible from the hubs to the customers. To reduce the time necessary to generate route maps, each section uses its own set
of Docker containers with a custom configuration that processes orders only in the section's area.
The company needs the ability to allocate resources cost-effectively based on the number of running containers.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
選項(英):
A. Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster on Amazon EC2. Use the Amazon EKS CLI to launch
the planning application in pods by using the --tags option to assign a custom tag to the pod.
B. Create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster on AWS Fargate. Use the Amazon EKS CLI to launch
the planning application. Use the AWS CLI tag-resource API call to assign a custom tag to the pod.
C. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on Amazon EC2. Use the AWS CLI with run-tasks set to
true to launch the planning application by using the --tags option to assign a custom tag to the task.
D. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on AWS Fargate. Use the AWS CLI run-task command
and set enableECSManagedTags to true to launch the planning application. Use the --tags option to assign a custom tag to
the task.
解析(英):
The core requirements of this question are "least operational overhead (LEAST operational overhead)" and "cost-effective resource allocation".

1. **Why D is the correct answer:**
   - **AWS Fargate** is a serverless container execution engine. Users do not need to manage the underlying EC2 execution entities (such as patching the operating system, expanding cluster capacity, etc.), which greatly reduces operating expenses.
   - **Amazon ECS** Compared to EKS, it is simpler to set up and manage for scenarios where only containerized tasks are required, especially when dealing with batch processing or task-oriented workloads.
   - Use the `run-task` command and enable `enableECSManagedTags` to automatically pass tags to tasks, which is very effective for cost tracking and resource management, and meets the requirements of the question for custom configuration.

2. **Why the other options are incorrect:**
